publisher_meaning.column: A: total this reporting period, not calendar-year-to-date
publisher_meaning.sections: pages 4, 6, 7; Column A period, line 19 composition, line 19 to line 6(c) transfer
publisher_meaning.scope: Reported total receipts, including multiple receipt families; not just donations, federal-only receipts, or available cash. No cycle-total equivalence is accepted.

paper.require: Complete captured response, one supported cover, valid filer/period, two explicit valid agreeing amount assertions. Missing or conflicting totals never select one cover slot.

metadata.date_policy: Exact date or midnight timestamp without a zone; no clipping, report-code period inference, or non-midnight truncation.
metadata.amount_policy: Preserve raw JSON; explicit numeric plain decimals convert to checked signed cents. Null, invalid, unsupported, or sub-cent values do not become zero.

comparison.grain: One captured metadata record against one exact-file cover and reporting interval; retain every pair separately.
comparison.delta: metadata minor units minus cover minor units, arbitrary-precision signed integer string
comparison.null_delta: Any missing or conflicting required scope, invalid/blank operand, unsupported layout/endpoint, multiple cover, or partial response.
comparison.not_blockers: Unrelated cover fields, cash continuity, year-to-date columns, and effective/latest amendment flags remain evidence but do not block a qualified same-file reported pair.
comparison.equality: Agreement between correlated publisher representations, not independent proof of accuracy or financial effectiveness.

non_goals: cycle summary versus Schedule A reconciliation
